note: The great houses (v2, M49). Each house of `realm` holds its `lands` (provinces) for the crown, and is only played while that realm is the player's. Loyalty (0 to 100) moves each month by `drift` of the gap toward its target: `base` + (Love - 50) x `love` + (Fear - 30) x `fear`, plus the house's favour (won by granting wants, fading by `favourFade` a month). Each house wants one thing at a time, by its traits: honours (crowns), a garrison (one of our armies in its lands), or a law. A want met gives `wants.favour`; unmet after `wants.patience` months it costs `wants.unmet` loyalty a month, and lapses after `wants.lapse`. A loyal house (`loyal` or more) sends `retinue` production a month; a sullen one (below `sullen`) adds `unrest` a month. Below `rising.below` a house may rise (`rising.chance` a month, less with Fear): its lands go over to it and a host takes the field at its seat. Retaking the seat brings it to judgement: pardon or the block.

pardon.name: Pardon
pardon.text: The house swears again and keeps its lands. The other houses note the crown's mercy.

block.name: The block
block.text: The head of the house goes to the block, and its lands to the crown. The other houses note the crown's justice.
